Hi Sophie — Marcus ran the recon and I generated a corrected invoice tied to PO 77821. Summary:
- Original line 'interim storage surcharge — prorated' was computed for the remaining 20 days of the billing cycle but the system erroneously used a per-GB rate that included planned feature tiering. We've corrected the unit rate to the published storage add-on rate and re-calculated the prorate.
- VAT has been applied correctly for an EU billing address with a valid VAT ID; the corrected invoice shows VAT at 23% with your VAT ID noted on the invoice.

Corrected totals (invoice CF-DF9283-rev1):
- Storage add-on prorated (4TB for 20 days): $1,642.40
- VAT (23%): $378.35
- Total: $2,020.75
